- **Breaded fish or chicken pieces with a rice-like coating:** The cluster covers about 150 x 270 px, roughly 9 x 16 cm. It is about 3 cm tall and loosely packed, so I estimate about 150 g.
- **Broccoli:** There are three florets. The biggest is about 7 cm across. I estimate about 90 g in total.
- **Yellow squash or zucchini slices:** There are about 4 thin slices, so I estimate about 60 g.
- **Rice:** Some rice is mixed into the coating. I counted it as a separate item at about 30 g.
